headline: Abu Dhabi Property Transactions Surge 76% to Dh171 Billion
summary: Abu Dhabi's real estate transactions jumped 76% to Dh171 billion in the first nine months of 2026, maintaining sector momentum despite geopolitical uncertainties.
why: Strong real estate transaction volumes indicate robust capital inflows and domestic demand within regional property markets.

impacts.name: Abu Dhabi Real Estate Sector
impacts.why: Property transactions increased significantly by 76% in the first nine months.
